themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, often framed as 'national priority' measures. This theme spans Spain, Italy, Poland, France, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, and Rassemblement National advocating for preferential treatment in housing, welfare, and employment.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in housing and public services, blocking non-citizen access to social benefits.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for Italian citizens' priority in welfare and housing, with Salvini pushing similar policies in Milan.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Promotes 'Polish priority' in social policies, opposing EU migrant redistribution schemes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Demands strict 'national preference' in welfare, housing, and employment, targeting non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Calls for 'British priority' in welfare and housing, proposing bans on non-citizen access to public services.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with Trump publicly criticizing Meloni for not supporting U.S. actions against Iran and NATO contributions. This theme is echoed in Italy, the U.S., France, and Spain, where far-right media amplify the tensions as a broader transatlantic divide.

countries.note: Media amplifies the Trump-Meloni feud as a symbol of broader U.S.-Europe tensions over defense and sovereignty.

countries.note: Criticizes Meloni for perceived weakness in standing up to Trump, framing it as a failure of European leadership.

themes.title: Far-right leaders celebrate Colombia's election
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing leaders in Argentina, the U.S., Spain, and France have publicly celebrated the narrow victory of Colombia's far-right presidential candidate, Abelardo de la Espriella. This theme highlights a transnational alignment of right-wing movements, framing the result as a regional shift toward conservative governance.

countries.note: Javier Milei congratulates De la Espriella, framing his victory as a triumph for free-market policies in Latin America.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump endorses De la Espriella, portraying his win as a rejection of leftist governance and a victory for U.S. interests.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Celebrates De la Espriella's victory as a regional shift toward conservative values and anti-socialist policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Highlights De la Espriella's win as part of a broader global right-wing resurgence, praising his anti-immigration stance.
